data.why: the repository ships only documentation screenshots (verification/samples/) and no real DICOM/NIfTI sample, so a stock single-slice CT DICOM file is handed to the browser as an upload.

goals: Load a DICOM CT slice and verify pixel data is correctly rescaled to Hounsfield Units using DICOM slope/intercept metadata
Navigate and window/level the image (CT presets, modality-aware display) to inspect anatomy
Draw a calibrated ROI circle and measure physical distance/angle and ROI HU statistics (mean, SD, coefficient of variation)
Run radiomics-style histogram/texture/shape feature extraction on the ROI and export the results as CSV/XLSX
Classify tissue from HU ranges and compare before/after or side-by-side images for longitudinal difference metrics
Export a de-identified DICOM, DICOM SR, and self-contained HTML research report and validate the export archive with scripts/validate_export.py

review.summary: The tree follows the README's workflow (load with HU check, display-only windowing, calibrated measurement, quantitative analysis, export with provenance) at a sensible depth, and every screen sampled matches its node. It needs small fixes before filing: two condition-style labels, misleading notes on the ROI circle and difference maps (neither exists in the UI as described), and a missing node for ROI-mask radiomics.
